evidence.reason: The fixture creates a temporary Git repo and makes its baseline commit without overriding inherited Git configuration. A developer-global `commit.gpgSign=true` can make line 94 fail for lack of a signing key, and an inherited `core.hooksPath` can run developer hooks during the fixture’s commits/checkouts. This is a concrete test-hermeticity defect in existing setup behavior; the minimal repair is to set `commit.gpgSign=false` and an empty fixture `core.hooksPath` (or isolate global config) before the first commit.
